Speaker comments on discussions, mentions need for policies, criticizes budget allocations, mentions parliamentary amendments, etc. Again, not a clear stance on a specific proposition. Both are speeches in hearings, not voting or explicit support/opposition to a specific proposal.

We need to see if they respond to same specific proposition. They are different topics (demographic change restructuring vs G20 healthy aging agenda). Not same proposition. Both have determinable positions? They express general support for aging policies, but not a specific proposition. The categories: INCOMPARABLE if both have determinable positions but not same proposition. RELATION_UNCERTAIN if unclear. INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE if at least one lacks determinable position on any specific proposition.

Do they have determinable position on a specific proposition? They discuss general policy, not a specific bill. So likely INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE because neither addresses a specific proposition. The definition: "pelo menos uma das manifestações não apresenta posição determinável sobre nenhuma proposição específica." Both lack specific proposition. So INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
